_readme: VoucherVault offer database. Every offer must come from the brand's own site/app, its affiliate network feed, or a reputable published source, with 'source' + 'verified' (YYYY-MM-DD, the day someone saw it live). 'expires' = the end date the brand publishes (null if none). Offers with no end date are hidden automatically once 'verified' is older than the recheck window for their kind (code 10 days, deal 14, gift 14, member 45), so stale codes never stay on the site. Store pages are generated from 'stores' by tools/sync-stores.js. 'link' = referral slug in shmor-site.json 'links' (optional; paste affiliate URLs there exactly as the network gives them).

nike.name: Nike
nike.about: Nike sells trainers, sportswear and kit worldwide through Nike.com and the Nike App. Its best-known savings are member and verified-group discounts rather than public sitewide codes.
tips: Nike's group discounts (students, military, first responders, educators) are verified one by one and issued as single-use codes.
Join Nike Membership (free) for the birthday-month offer.
Discount codes usually exclude SNKRS launches, Nike By You and gift cards.

under-armour.name: Under Armour
under-armour.about: Under Armour makes performance sportswear, trainers and accessories. Its US store runs outlet codes, a sign-up discount and a 20% discount for heroes and teachers verified through ID.me.
tips: The ID.me discount can't be combined with promo codes, so compare which saves more.
Outlet codes such as EXTRA25 apply to selected outlet lines only.
Standard shipping is free over the threshold shown on the site.

puma.name: PUMA
puma.about: PUMA sells trainers, football boots and sportswear. Its US store regularly runs multi-buy codes advertised in the banner at the top of the site.
tips: Multi-buy codes reward bigger baskets: check whether adding one more item unlocks a better tier.
Banner codes change often, so check the end date on PUMA's site before you buy.

gymshark.name: Gymshark
gymshark.about: Gymshark is a gym-wear brand selling online worldwide. It offers a sign-up discount, a student discount through Student Beans and a refer-a-friend reward.
tips: Student discounts are verified through Student Beans before you get a code.
Offers shown here were seen on gymshark.com's US store; other regional stores may differ.

the-north-face.name: The North Face
the-north-face.about: The North Face sells outdoor jackets, fleeces, backpacks and footwear. Its free XPLR Pass loyalty programme gives new members a discount on their next purchase.
tips: XPLR Pass is free to join; exclusions apply to the welcome discount.
Outdoor brands discount most around Black Friday and end-of-season sales.

asos.name: ASOS
asos.about: ASOS is an online fashion retailer selling its own labels and hundreds of brands. New customers get a first-order code, and it runs coded promotions on selected brands.
tips: The first-order code is different in the app (HEYAPP) and on the website (NEWHERE).
First-order codes only work on a brand-new account.

old-navy.name: Old Navy
old-navy.about: Old Navy, part of Gap Inc., sells affordable clothing for the whole family. Its site advertises codes such as extra money off clearance in the top banner.
tips: Clearance codes stack on already-reduced prices, so the final discount can be big.
Check the banner for the current code and end date before checkout.

kohls.name: Kohl's
kohls.about: Kohl's is a US department store selling clothing, home and beauty. It is known for coupon codes on 'coupon-eligible' items and a text sign-up discount.
tips: Codes only apply to items marked coupon-eligible; many brands are excluded.
Kohl's shows the price with the code applied on eligible product listings.

uniqlo.name: UNIQLO
uniqlo.about: UNIQLO is a Japanese clothing brand known for basics such as HEATTECH and down jackets. Its US store runs limited-time offers and a new app member reward.
tips: 'Limited-Time Offers' are price drops with no code needed.
The app welcome reward works online or in store.

lookfantastic.name: LOOKFANTASTIC
lookfantastic.about: LOOKFANTASTIC is a UK-based online beauty retailer selling skincare, haircare, make-up and fragrance. It publishes its current codes and gift-with-purchase offers, with end dates, on its own discount-codes page.
tips: Gift-with-purchase offers are added in the basket automatically while stocks last.
App-exclusive offers only work in the LOOKFANTASTIC app.

sephora.name: Sephora
sephora.about: Sephora sells make-up, skincare, haircare and fragrance. Its US site regularly offers free samples or gifts with a minimum spend using a code.
tips: Sample-bag codes have a minimum spend; terms apply.
Sephora's Beauty Insider programme is free to join.

dell.name: Dell
dell.about: Dell sells laptops, desktops, monitors and accessories direct. Beyond its weekly deals it offers verified member discounts for students, teachers, the military, medical workers, first responders and seniors.
tips: Member discounts need you to verify your status with Dell first.
Dell Rewards is free and gives back credit on future purchases.
Dell says it will price-match a better online price.

lenovo.name: Lenovo
lenovo.about: Lenovo makes ThinkPad, Yoga, Legion and IdeaPad laptops. Its US store attaches 'eCoupons' to individual products, shown on the product listing.
tips: Lenovo eCoupons are product-specific and often limited to one unit.
Doorbuster prices may need no code at all.

samsung.name: Samsung
samsung.about: Samsung sells Galaxy phones, tablets, TVs and appliances direct. Its offer programmes give extra savings to students, teachers, government, military and corporate employees.
tips: Trade-in credit depends on the condition checks Samsung lists.
Offer-programme prices need a Samsung account and verification.

events.name: Singles' Day (11.11)
events.text: The world's biggest online shopping day started in China; AliExpress and many global brands now run 11.11 sales.

events.name: Black Friday
events.text: The day after US Thanksgiving (26 November 2026). Most retailers in the US, UK and EU start offers days or weeks earlier.

events.name: Cyber Monday
events.text: The Monday after Black Friday, focused on online and tech deals.

events.name: Boxing Day sales
events.text: The UK's traditional post-Christmas sale; many stores start online on Christmas Day.
